impact: Relief for MU, DRAM, SNXX and GOOGL after the selloff; the question is whether it holds once ANT starts trading and soaks up AI money.
summary: Tech led early Thursday trading: the Nasdaq Composite rose about 1.7% to 24,844.98 and the S&P 500 about 0.9%, with Nvidia up about 4% (still down about 23% this month) and Micron up roughly 5% to 6%; Google and SanDisk also gained. Yahoo Finance later reported the Dow and S&P 500 giving up their gains ahead of Anthropic's first trade, with indications pointing to ANT opening about 25% above its $83 IPO price (around $105).
title: Chips rally at the open: Micron up ~5%, Nvidia ~4% before Anthropic's debut
